scope: Post-hoc training-only threshold selection on previously inspected development patients; no external validation
selection: Mean balanced accuracy of complete inner OOF predictions across five repeats; among quantiles within 0.02 of the maximum choose nearest 0.5, then lower quantile for an exact tie
transfer: A quantile specifies the cutoff of each training-score distribution; use numpy quantile(method=linear). Reconstruct frozen outer model scores on outer training patients, compute its training quantile, and classify untouched outer test scores >= cutoff as MCS
estimand: Within each seed concatenate its five held-out folds, compute sensitivity and specificity then balanced accuracy; average these rates over five seeds. This differs from mean within-fold AUROC.

uncertainty.method: Patient-paired exponential Dirichlet weights shared across five test appearances, methods and threshold strategies; independent cohort streams; equal cohort macro

stability: Report outer threshold quantile SD, raw-cutoff IQR and range, and seed metric range. Shrinkage halves quantile SD by construction; it does not guarantee smaller raw-cutoff variability or higher test performance.
stopping: Freeze this complete menu before execution; do not adjust grid, tolerance, shrinkage or method choice based on outer results. Preserve adverse outcomes. Refuse overwriting existing outputs.
